items.title: We’re Entering Election “Silly Season,” and It Sure Feels Especially Stupid This Year
items.content: If we make it through these midterms with one brain cell intact, it will be a small miracle.

items.title: What Happens When You Take a Major GOP Donor and a Liberal Environmentalist Fishing? Something Beautiful, Actually
items.content: Doug Deason and Luke Metzger have almost nothing in common politically. Get them outdoors, though, and they’ll teach you a thing or two about bipartisanship. And about angling.

items.title: I Sure as Hell Hope That Pete Hegseth Doesn’t End Up in the Senate
items.content: The Secretary of Talking About War is apparently hoping to escape from the hellhole he created at the Pentagon.

items.title: Turns Out, Even Children’s Toys Can Set Off International Outrage
items.content: Hello Kitty–gate might be the news story I least expected this week.

items.title: The Trump Administration Is Spying on Americans at a Scale Not Seen Since the 1960s
items.content: Of course they’re using ICE to do it.

items.title: Don’t Ask Trump How His Revenge Tour Is Going
items.content: The president keeps trying and failing to legally ruin his enemies.

items.title: A Disturbing New Report Reveals the Extent of Trump and Epstein’s Twisted Relationship
items.content: I don’t think Attorney General Todd Blanche has a big enough shovel to bury all of this.

items.title: Trump Took a Quick Break from Bashing Windmills to Spew Nonsense About Solar Panels
items.content: “The animals jump on them and they fry,” the president said, among other things.

items.title: What Lies Beneath the Noise
items.content: In 1980, I made the first big error of my political-writing career by not trusting my intuition. As we approach historic midterms, I won’t make the same mistake.

items.title: A Federal Judge Just Smacked Down Trump’s Hopes for a “Sweeping Theory” of Executive Power
items.content: The ruling claims the administration unlawfully fired federal prosecutor Maurene Comey, daughter of famous seashell-threatener James Comey.

items.title: The Cheesecake Factory Isn’t the Symbol of Flyover America That Right-Wing Pundits Think It Is
items.content: Obama jokingly compared Trump’s White House to the restaurant chain, then out came the fun police.

items.title: Kids Can’t Even Enjoy the Woods Anymore
items.content: Invasive insects are destroying America’s forests, and I don’t like what that means for our future.

items.title: We Need to Prepare Ourselves for One of the Most Intensely Monitored Elections in American History
items.content: The ratfcking has just begun.

items.title: The Legal System Is Taking Another Shot at Forcing Trump to Tell the Truth About January 6
When You’ve Got 6,000 State Senate Seats to Fill, You’re Occasionally Going to Elect a Homophobic Sauerkraut Salesman
items.content: It is that time in the election cycle when we look around the country for the strange and wonderful about representative democracy.

items.title: Sorry, JD Vance—Vivek Ramaswamy Just Took the Title of Ohio’s Most Unlikable Politician
items.content: The gubernatorial candidate has associated himself with the vilest, most inhumane advertisement in the history of American politics.

items.title: Canada Rightfully Decides That It Will Never Be the 51st State
items.content: Unfortunately, that doesn’t mean the president’s influence hasn’t wafted its way to our northern neighbor like a toxic cloud.

items.title: “I’ve Never Studied the Body of a Man Before,” Says Trump Before Describing Jon Husted’s Ass in Gross Detail
items.content: Maybe the president and his favorite senator should run off into the sunset together. It would save us all a lot of grief.

items.title: The President Sure Cut the FBI’s Public Corruption Teams at a Convenient Time
items.content: The CEO of a naval firm went to prison for bribing public officials, but why aren’t the people who took his company’s money? In Trump’s America, I guess we’ll never know.
